Independent eigenline dimension bounds prove exact extrema with equality classification. Counting split/Jordan/irreducible classes modulo scalar matrices proves all \(n=2\) multiplicities. Exact inequalities establish Ramanujan iff \(n=2\), including the exceptional bipartite cube. Every character was separately enumerated over (n,q)=(2,2),(2,3),(2,5),(3,2); no finite extrapolation is used in the proof.
